work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLXXXIV (address LF40290–40292 to the ordinaries and vicars apostolic of China and neighbouring kingdoms; protocol LF40295) renews for twenty-five years Benedict XIV’s matrimonial dispensing faculties, inserting his brief; LF40307 → LF40316 across own provenance LF40310 and running title LF40313; across page numbers LF40385, LF40452 and running title LF40521; complete 17 August 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40295–40295; the source closing at LF40533–40536 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die decima septima augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
